Loading data and creating list of Country_objects

Source: R/Loader.R
create_country_list.Rd

Function for creating a country objects list

Usage

create_country_list(
  start_year = 2020,
  start_fertility_group = 3,
  switching_pattern = list(c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3), c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3)),
  data_list = base_data_list,
  progress_bar = TRUE,
  post_switch = FALSE,
  on_country_mismatch = c("error", "rescale", "ignore")
)

Arguments

start_year

Numeric; starting year of the projection (default 2020).

start_fertility_group

Numeric; index of the youngest age group for which fertility is applied. Default 3, corresponding to the 10-14 age group.

switching_pattern

List of two numeric vectors; specifies for each switching cohort the distribution of religious switching across sub-periods. The first switchable age group is 15-19. Default `list(c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3), c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3))`, distributing switching uniformly across 15-19, 20-24 and 25-29.

data_list

List; named list of data frames containing pre-loaded projection input data (default [base_data_list]).

progress_bar

Logical; whether to show a progress bar and ETA during loading (default TRUE).

post_switch

Logical; controls how religious switching is tracked across periods. If FALSE (default), individuals who have switched religion remain in the general population and may switch again in subsequent steps. If TRUE, those who have switched are moved into separate post-switch columns and excluded from further switching. Forwarded to internal country object creation.

on_country_mismatch

Character; how to handle a mismatch between the number of countries in the migration destination matrix and `info_variants`. One of `"error"`, `"rescale"` (renormalise destination rows to sum to 1), or `"ignore"`. In interactive sessions without an explicit value the user is prompted.

Value

List of country objects, each containing demographic and model-specific data used in the MRC projection framework. Each element of the list represents a single country.

See also

create_projection_object to assemble a projection from this list, variants_loader to validate the assembled object, project to run the projection. vignette("conducting-projections") for a complete worked example. vignette("inner-workings") for the internal data-loading pipeline.

Examples

test_cl <- create_country_list(
  start_year = 2025,
  start_fertility_group = 4,
  switching_pattern = list(
    c(1 / 3, 1 / 3, 1 / 3),
    c(1 / 3, 1 / 3, 1 / 3)
  ),
  data_list = base_data_list,
  progress_bar = FALSE,
  post_switch = FALSE,
  on_country_mismatch = "error"
)
